title: More fathers are taking paternity leave, but mothers are still doing all the work ｜ 越来越多的父亲开始休陪产假，但母亲仍在承担所有家务

sents.en: Attitudes towards paternity leave have drastically changed in America in the last five years as more fathers feel comfortable taking extended time off, but gender bias persists when it comes to career prospects and the home, according to a new study of working parents.
sents.cn: 一项针对在职父母的新研究显示，过去五年里，随着越来越多的父亲能够坦然休长假，美国人对陪产假的态度发生了巨大转变；但在职业前景与家庭内部，性别偏见依然存在。

sents.en: Research by the Boston College Center for Work & Family, which surveyed new parents at four large US companies who were qualified for taking at least six weeks paid parental leave, found that 81% of the 1,240 employees surveyed said the notion of fathers taking leave has become more acceptable.
sents.cn: 波士顿学院工作与家庭中心对四家美国大公司中有资格休至少六周带薪育儿假的初为父母者进行了调查，研究发现，在接受调查的1,240名员工中，81%的人表示“父亲休假”这一观念已变得更容易被接受。

sents.en: Of those surveyed, 62% of fathers took the maximum amount of time off compared to 93% of mothers, and around three-quarters of workers said their employer was equally supportive of mothers and fathers taking parental leave and over half said leave policies had made workplace culture better.
sents.cn: 在接受调查者中，62%的父亲休满了最长假期，而母亲这一比例为93%；约四分之三的员工表示，雇主对父母双方休育儿假同样支持，超过一半的人认为休假政策改善了职场文化。

sents.en: The US is one of only three countries in the world not to offer statutory paid leave, but increasingly states and companies are starting to take up the issue.
sents.cn: 美国是全球仅有的三个不提供法定带薪休假的国家之一，但各州和企业正越来越多地着手应对这一问题。

sents.en: So far, eight states and the District of Columbia have their own paid family leave laws.
sents.cn: 迄今为止，已有八个州和哥伦比亚特区制定了各自的带薪家庭休假法。

sents.en: Brad Harrington, executive director of the center and lead author of the study, estimates only 20% to 30% of companies in the US offer paid parental leave.
sents.cn: 该中心主任、本研究的主要作者布拉德∙哈林顿估计，美国仅有20%至30%的公司提供带薪育儿假。

sents.en: He feels the research findings reflect an obvious change in corporate attitudes to new fathers taking time off.
sents.cn: 他认为，这一研究结果反映出企业在对待新手父亲休假问题上的态度发生了明显转变。

sents.en: "We did a study on paternity leave five years ago.
sents.cn: “我们五年前做过一项关于陪产假的研究。

sents.en: Compared with those findings, these numbers were shocking to me.
sents.cn: 与当时的发现相比，这些数字让我震惊。

sents.en: I did not expect 80% of people to say the organisation finds dads taking this leave acceptable and three-quarters to say it's equally supportive of women and men taking leave," Harrington said.
sents.cn: 我没想到会有80%的人说所在机构认为父亲休这种假是可接受的，也没想到会有四分之三的人说机构对男女休假同样支持，”哈林顿说。

sents.en: The previous study found that nearly three-quarters of fathers saw two to four weeks as an appropriate duration for paternity leave and 76% said they would prefer not to take all their time off at once.
sents.cn: 此前的研究发现，近四分之三的父亲认为两到四周是合适的陪产假时长，76%的人表示不愿一次性休完全部假期。

sents.en: Since then, there have been a number of legal cases against companies involving paternity leave·including cases against JPMorgan Chase and Estée Lauder·which have helped put pressure on companies to make their parental leave policies gender neutral.
sents.cn: 自那以后，出现了多起针对企业的、涉及陪产假的诉讼——包括对摩根大通和雅诗兰黛的诉讼——这些诉讼促使企业承受压力，使其育儿假政策走向性别中立。

sents.en: However, the study also shows how traditional gender roles endure both at work, where more women than men reported changes in their perceived career potential, and at home· even among workers who claim to have a strong desire for equality.
sents.cn: 然而，研究也显示出传统性别角色是如何在工作场所（更多女性而非男性表示感知到的职业潜力发生了变化）和家中得以延续的——即便在那些自称强烈渴望平等的劳动者中间也是如此。

sents.en: The vast majority of men, 97%, said one of the top reasons to take leave was to share caregiving with their partner.
sents.cn: 绝大多数男性（97%）表示，休假的首要原因之一是与伴侣分担照料责任。

sents.en: But when they were asked about how caregiving and household tasks were divided, their answers painted a different picture.
sents.cn: 但当被问及照料与家务如何分配时，他们的回答却呈现另一番景象。

sents.en: While about 75% of employees said both genders should give the same amount of care, the majority of men and nearly half of women admitted that in reality the female actually did most of it.
sents.cn: 虽然约75%的员工认为两性应付出同等的照料，但大多数男性和近一半女性承认，现实中其实是女性承担了大部分。

sents.en: A tiny fraction, 2%, of men said they did more of the childcare.
sents.cn: 仅有2%的男性说自己做了更多育儿工作。

sents.en: Men and women's experiences of the return to work following parental leave were also considerably different.
sents.cn: 男女在育儿假后重返工作岗位的经历也大不相同。

sents.en: Of the women surveyed, 32% reported a downturn in their job satisfaction, while 14% said it increased.
sents.cn: 接受调查的女性中，32%表示工作满意度下降，14%表示上升；

sents.en: In comparison, 17% of men said their job satisfaction went down and 20% said it went up.
sents.cn: 相比之下，17%的男性说满意度下降，20%说上升。

sents.en: Meanwhile, more women reported an increase in their responsibilities and manager expectations after childbirth.
sents.cn: 与此同时，更多女性表示生育后责任与管理者的期望增加了。

sents.en: Half of the women said they used flexible work arrangements after becoming a parent, while just 27% of men did.
sents.cn: 一半女性说成为父母后使用了弹性工作制，男性仅27%。

sents.en: Similar percentages of men and women said they enjoyed their careers and that it gave them a sense of achievement, while around half of women and 44% of men said it was a key part of their identity.
sents.cn: 表示享受事业并从中获得成就感的男女比例相近，而约一半女性和44%的男性认为事业是自我认同的关键部分。

sents.en: On the subject of career advancement, 59% of women and 49% of men said leave could be limiting and both genders said they feared it would have an impact on their progress long-term.
sents.cn: 在职业晋升方面，59%的女性和49%的男性认为休假可能带来限制，两性都表示担心这会对长远发展产生影响。

sents.en: But on opportunity for promotion, more than double the number of women, 30% compared with 15% of men, believed their chances to be lower after becoming a parent.
sents.cn: 但在晋升机会上，认为成为父母后机会变低的女性数量是男性的两倍多——女性30%，男性仅15%。

sents.en: Despite progress, the struggle for women to reach the highest positions of power is demonstrated in this year's Fortune 500 list, which featured a record 33 female CEOs, but this still represents a tiny fraction of the total.
sents.cn: 尽管有所进步，女性冲击最高权力职位的艰难由此可见一斑：今年《财富》500强榜单上有创纪录的33位女性CEO，但这仍只占总量的极小部分。

sents.en: Harrington said culture change depends on companies putting more focus on men and their responsibilities.
sents.cn: 哈林顿说，文化变革取决于企业更多地关注男性及其责任。“我的意思是，企业需要给男性陪产假，并鼓励男性在孩子年幼时抽时间陪伴。

sents.en: "By that I mean companies need to give men paternity leave and encourage men to take time off to be with their kids early on in the kids' life.
sents.cn: 他们也需要认识到，男性成为父亲后必须做出重大调整。

sents.en: They also need to recognise that men have to make significant adjustments when they become parents.
sents.cn: 企业不能一方面为了促进女性晋升做足了功夫，转头却又说‘噢，但我们可没指望男人在家里接替女人’。

sents.en: Companies cannot do all these things to enhance women's advancement and then turn around and say, 'Oh, but we don't expect the men to take over for the women at home.'"

In May, the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) and Outten & Golden LLP announced a historic class-action $5m settlement with JPMorgan Chase on behalf of male employees who claim they were illegally denied access to paid parental leave.
sents.cn: 今年5月，美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）与奥特滕&戈登律师事务所宣布，就一桩具有历史意义的集体诉讼，与摩根大通达成500万美元和解，代表那些声称被非法剥夺带薪育儿假资格的男性员工。

sents.en: Derek Rotondo, 35, filed the discrimination charge against his company after he was allegedly told by his HR department that mothers were considered primary caregivers.
sents.cn: 35岁的德里克∙罗顿多向公司提起歧视指控，起因据称是人力资源部告诉他，母亲被视为主要照料者，因此可休16周带薪育儿假，而父亲却只能休两周。

sents.en: Thus, they were allowed to take 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
sents.cn: O）这位来自俄亥俄州哥伦布市、有两个孩子、目前在公司以助理调查员身份在职的父亲说，自和解以来，他目睹了企业界出现“多米诺效应”，但在改变对陪产假的态度方面，仍有大量进展要做。

sents.en: Fathers, however, could take just two weeks.
sents.cn: P）“我确实认为还有一段路要走……对于新手爸爸，仍会有某种不言而喻的期待，即他们基本上要立刻返岗，但我认为研究显示这种情况正在开始改变。

sents.en: O) The father of two from Columbus, Ohio, who still works at the company as an associate and investigator, said he has witnessed a "domino effect" across companies since the settlement, but that there is still substantial progress to be made towards changing attitudes towards paternity leave.
sents.cn: ”他说，平等的育儿假是在职场实现性别平等的重要组成部分。

sents.en: P) "I do think there's still some way to go...there's still going to be sort of the unstated expectation for new dads to essentially come right back to work, but I think the research is showing that's starting to change." He said equal parental leave is an essential component to creating gender equality in the workplace.
sents.cn: “女性待在家里、生儿育女、做饭的旧标准已经不适用，而且很久都不适用了。

sents.en: "The old standard of women staying home, having babies and cooking doesn't apply and hasn't applied for a long time."
